notes.title: Demo Update ver. 1.7.3+31063cd3
notes.notes:
Hey again zomboarders!

As always, thank you all once again for taking the time to play the demo for Radical Zomboarding. I've made some changes as a direct result of your feedback, so I hope you enjoy it!

Here's the changelog for 6-23-25 (ver. 1.7.3+31063cd3): 

Additions:

Lots and lots of zombies! To be exact, there are now ten times more zombies on the slope! Along with this, instead of spawning at the same spot every time, zombies now spawn at random locations on the main slope.

Boosting while on a rail now boosts your speed (sorry about that, should have been there to begin with)

 Fixes: 

Fixed an issue where holding the grab button THEN pressing a direction would not activate a grabbed trick

Fixed a rare issue where the player would wipe out if the player's head collided with a specific zombie giblet

Fixed an issue where the Explosive Entrance perk would give way too much mult (it was multiplying your multiplier instead of adding to multiplier)

Fixed an issue where the time added UI would not stack when earning multiple seconds of time

Fixed how airtime is calculated (would previously stop counting airtime while doing tricks, and also wouldn't count airtime until you were going down from a jump)

Fixed how Feathery Flip calculates the increased trick speed (1 + (number of empty slots * 0.25))

Fixed various performance bottlenecks relating to blood splatters and zombie LODs

Fixed(?) an issue where Chill Grind would continuously activate if you bailed while grinding

Fixed an issue where the player's aiming arm would stay outstretched while doing a chainsaw attack

 Changes: 

Changed the run start time from 180 seconds to 30 to account for the large number of zombies added to the slope. If you want to stay alive you better get shredding!

Made the timing for chainsaw attacks more lenient (from 0.4 seconds to 0.6 seconds)

Perks now have a small animation when they activate so you know which perk activated

Added an animated UI element that plays when earning cash

Moved a turret onto the main path so that it's easier to destroy

Debuffed Feathery Flip from adding 0.5 per empty slot to 0.25 as a result of fixing how it calculates the new trick speed

Jump Boots now give multiplier while in the air instead of when you land

Air Bud perk now doubles how high you go from doing a shotgun jump instead of allowing you to shoot twice mid-air

Reverting back to a standard versioning system (Major.Minor.Patch+LastCommitHash)


That's it for now! As always, thank you all for your suggestions and I hope you'll enjoy the next update!

Until next time!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix v0.0206.0114
notes.notes:
Hey again zomboarders!

I'll make this quick. I made some mistakes when I released the major overhaul update, so here's the changelog for this hotfix:

Update for 6-02-25 (ver. v0.0206.0114):

Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the "challenge complete" confetti effect would play during the tutorial when it shouldn't
 Fix the Challenge Manager behavior so that it correctly assigns the correct challenge when starting a run
 Fixed an issue where the Challenge Manager would pick a boss challenge before completing two other challenges as intended
 Fixed an issue where the controls would not be restored when completing the tutorial, causing you to be unable to do tricks until you restarted the game
 Fixed an issue where players couldn't customize their characters after completing a tutorial unless they restarted the game
 Fixed an issue where the "Challenge Complete!" text would not be shown in the shop after completing the tutorial
 Fixed an issue where completed boss challenges could be picked multiple times per run
 Fixed an issue where completed score challenges would be shoved back into the available challenge queue when completing a run (which wouldn't be noticed by players but would eventually cause a memory leak)


As always, thank you all for playing and I hope you'll enjoy the next update!

Until next time!

notes.title: Demo Update v1.6 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey zomboarders!

Thank you all once again for taking the time to play the demo for Radical Zomboarding!

Another update just went out! I hope you'll enjoy it. Here's the changelog:

Update for 4-09-25:

Additions:

 Added tracer rounds to the shotgun so you can see where your bullets go when firing
 Gore and giblets now inherit your velocity so now you can really see the bones and flesh bits fly


Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where turrets could still lock on to you (but not shoot a missile) even after being destroyed
 Fixed an issue where the controller visuals still showed long tricks even though they were removed
 Fixed an issue where the grab command was not present for the keyboard controls in the load screen and pause screen


Changes:

 Changed how the hitbox works for the shotgun. You will now only aim at zombies that are directly ahead of you, and won't aim at the zombies behind you.
 Clarified how to complete the "Do a 360/720/1080" challenge


That's it for now! As always, thank you all for your suggestions and I hope you'll enjoy the next update!

Until next time!

notes.title: Demo Update v1.5 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey zomboarders!

Thank you all once again for taking the time to play the demo for Radical Zomboarding!

Another update just went out, and this one is a real fun one:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528744/c645b9f167a5d71060a3fbf8d7d5f4511eb3b14f.png

This update features MORE BLOOD AND GUTS! I hope you'll enjoy it! Here's the changelog:

Update for 3-28-25:

Additions:

 NEW GORE SYSTEM!
 Killed zombies now explode into bones and giblets
 Bones and blood sprays now leave blood splatters on the slope
 Blood can splatter on the screen when killing zombies or when getting bitten
 Each slope has its own cash multiplier; The Bunny Slope multiplier is 10 and the Alpine Park multiplier is 20


Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where holding a diagonal direction and then doing a grab would result in the animation not playing
 Fixed an issue where the scoring UI would show an increasingly exponentially large score
 Fixed the score UI so that only the stale moves in a string would appear greyed out instead of greying out the entire string of moves
 Fixed not being able to perform an air shot right after jumping
 Fixed an issue where the active cheats would not be highlighted when activating them and then returning from a run
 Fixed an issue where the Tornado Twist perk would not reset when quitting or restarting a run


Changes:

 Update how cash is earned from a run: Cash earned is now calculated as the number of challenges completed multiplied by the slope's cash multiplier. If you used cheats, the earned cash will be multiplied by the lowest cheat multiplier
 The Ludicrous Speed cheat now has a 0.2 cash multiplier, reducing earned cash from a run by 1/5
 Updated the air trick challenges to only count short or medium tricks
 Changed grabs so they now require you to hold the grab for a majority of the jump for it to count as a grabbed trick
 Rebalanced the score earned for each trick
 Show a message in the trick UI when locking in a score or bailing
 Cheats now have a cash earned multiplier; some cheats will reduce the amount of cash you earn, others will increase them!
 Updated the cheat screen with descriptions and multipliers for each cheat


Removals:

 Slides and wall rides no longer count as tricks


That's it for now! As always, thank you all for your suggestions and I hope you'll enjoy the next update!

Until next time!

notes.title: Demo Update v1.3 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey zomboarders!

Thank you all once again for taking the time to play the demo for Radical Zomboarding!

Another update just went out, so I hope you'll have fun with it! Here's the changelog:

Update for 3-20-25:

Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where perks activated from a chainsaw move would trigger twice
 Fixed an issue where the challenge text could overlap the timer
 Fixed an issue where the gravity would not reset after certain boss challenges


Adjustments/Improvements:

 Refined the player controller so the player no longer bounces along the ground. This should make the characters feel much better to control overall
 Increased turning radius at low speeds
 Improved how jumps are handled: Instead of the jump charge going straight to 0 when leaving the ground, the jump's charge will now gradually decrease as you stay in the air
 Jumps now have "coyote time" where if you leave the ground and have at least 90% of a jump charged up and then release it, you can still jump from the air as if you had jumped off the ground
 Changed the named jumps ("big jump", "huge jump", etc) so that they display exactly how many seconds of air time you had after you land ("2 sec jump", "5 sec jump", etc)
 You can now both brake and boost yourself while grinding a rail for finer control of your rail grind
 Removed the Goldfish and Reverse Psychology perks (for now). No one was buying them, so they're going back to the drawing board for a rework.


Additions:

 New perk: Feathery Flip - Trick speed increases for every empty perk slot
 New perk: Tornado Twist - Every chainsawed tree increases your air rotation speed
 New perk: Dust Devil - Get a speed boost on landing for every 360 spin in the air


That's it for now! As always, thank you all for your suggestions and I hope you'll enjoy the next update!

Until next time!

notes.title: Demo Update v1.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey zomboarders!

Thank you all once again for taking the time to play the demo for Radical Zomboarding!

That said, I have another update live for you all, so I hope you'll enjoy it! Here's the changelog:

Update for 3-15-25:

Fixes:

 Fixed various issues with rails where you could potentially wipe out while grinding if you're not going fast enough
 Fixed an issue where the radial blur would appear if you moved the right analog stick while in the helicopter
 Fixed an issue where cheat codes would appear multiple times in the cheats menu after every run started
 Fixed an issue where unlocked items would appear in the popup window with the old font
 Fixed abnormal behavior caused by pausing while entering the helicopter
 Fixed the inability to pause while wiping out
 Fixed an issue where attached zombies and particles would not pause when the game paused
 Removed the cheats tab in the pause menu's settings to prevent issues stemming from cheats activated mid-run (so activate your cheats before you start a run!)


Adjustments/Improvements:

 Tricks are now far more lenient; they no longer rely on the entire animation being finished in order to land the trick, but instead have a threshold where as long as MOST of the trick is complete before landing, you should land the trick with no trouble.
 The Organ Tail challenge has been removed (at least until I figure out why it's the single most commonly incomplete challenge)
 Challenges that ask you to complete a specific trick have updated titles and descriptions which make it more clear on how to perform the trick it asks you to perform


Additions:

 Coins can now spawn on rails! Up to a maximum of 4 coins can spawn on certain rails every time a run is started, so now you have more of an incentive to grind rails.


And that's it! As always, thank you all for your suggestions and I hope you'll enjoy the next update!

Until next time!

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey zomboarders!

First, thank you all for taking the time to play the demo for Radical Zomboarding! I am sincerely grateful for the outpouring of support, feedback, and suggestions for the game.

Thanks to your feedback, I implemented a slew of improvements and additions which I hope you'll all enjoy! You can read more about them in the changelog below:

Update for 3-11-25:

Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where pressing the long trick button would cause you to slide on the ground (note: there are no long tricks yet, this was a holdover from a super old version of the game)
 Fixed an issue where you could only do an Indy or a Stalefish when attempting a grab with a controller which would render certain challenges impossible
 Fixed an issue where gravity wouldn't reset after completing a challenge that altered gravity
 Fixed descriptions of a few challenges that referenced long tricks
 Fixed an issue where buying a perk then selling it still showed the card cost as "Purchased!" instead of the perk's actual cost
 Fixed the Flairtender's posture and the normals on the Flairtender's hat
 Fixed an issue where the boss challenge could potentially appear smaller if the previous boss challenge animation was interrupted
 Fixed an issue where subsequent runs could earn more and more money due to the number of challenges completed and perks purchased not being reset. Congrats to those who exploited this to earn a bunch of cash!


Adjustments/Improvements:

 Adjusted the input handler so trick directions are easier to use when using a controller
 Adjusted the required speed for the speed challenges. Also clarified their descriptions to note the speed must be reached while riding on the ground and not the air.
 Capped the bail/wipeout time to a maximum of 6 seconds instead of the previous 10
 Improved speed boosts at lower speeds
 Improved performance when showing controls on the loading screen
 Improved visual feedback on selected UI elements


Additions:

 Added a new Bunny Slope which serves as an introductory slope for new zomboarders and has no turrets or barrels
 Added a speedometer which will show your current speed
 Added a yeti character
 Added SFX when buying a perk mid-run, selling a perk, or buying a character/board/etc in the progression shop


Anyway, once more, thank you all for your suggestions and I hope to hear more from you all!

Until next time!
